## TS-001 Actuation
Alternatives: centralized hydraulic; distributed electrohydraulic; electromechanical. Compare power density, controllability, leakage/fire risk, stored energy, maintainability, mass, noise, heat, fault response, supply chain, simulation fidelity and cost. **No winner selected.**

TS-001 also covers the power source that goes with each actuation alternative. Until it closes, two named
alternatives are analysed side by side (decision DQ-006, lead, 2026-11-12):

| Alternative | Power and actuation | Item-definition elements | Hazards specific to it |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Centralised hydraulic: hydraulic power unit, accumulators, valve-controlled joints | `SUS-M1-PWR-HPU` | HAZ-PWR-001 (stored hydraulic pressure) |
| B | Series-hybrid: engine-generator and battery feeding electric or electrohydraulic joints | `SUS-M1-PWR-GEN`, `SUS-M1-PWR-BAT` | HAZ-PWR-002 (battery thermal runaway), HAZ-PWR-003 (fuel fire) |

Each power hazard names its alternative in `applicability.hardware`; hazards with no alternative listed apply to both.

**Study record.** TS-001 is in work as a record, [`architecture/trades/TS-001.yaml`](../architecture/trades/TS-001.yaml),
shown on the generated [Trade Studies](../docs/wiki/Trade-Studies.md) page. It splits alternative B by joint actuator
(electrohydraulic B-EHA, electromechanical B-EMA), holds the criteria weights the lead confirmed (decision DQ-016), and scores
only what has evidence: so far fault response, from the walker simulations
([`sim/results/ts001-fault-response.md`](../sim/results/ts001-fault-response.md)).

## TS-002 Pilot architecture
Alternatives: seated protected cockpit; standing open-frame pilot; remote operator. Compare ergonomics, ingress/egress, restraint, fall/rollover protection, visibility, emergency extraction, human-machine interface and structural packaging.

## TS-003 Locomotion
Alternatives: bipedal; quadrupedal; hybrid leg-wheel. Compare stability, complexity, energy consumption, terrain capability, fall consequences and testability.

## TS-004 UAV docking
Alternatives: rear backpack dock; shoulder-mounted dock; separate portable station. Compare rotor clearance, center of gravity, accessibility, charging, environmental protection, approach geometry, emergency separation and operator exposure.

## Decision process
Each study records criteria, weights, assumptions, quantitative evidence, safety impact, reviewer, decision authority, selected baseline and linked change request. Rendered concepts are not evidence of feasibility.
